title: List the threats detected by Defender
description: Show the history of the threats detected and blocked by Windows Defender.

examples.description: Show the detailed history of every detection with its actions

notes: SeverityID: 0=Unknown, 1=Low, 2=Medium, 4=High, 5=Severe. Resources: path of the infected files. IsActive: $true when the threat is still present. Get-MpThreatDetection: detailed history with the actions taken.
